description:
The DAHON Cargoe T8 is designed to meet the demands of heavy-duty riders, combining innovative technology with practical features for an unmatched riding experience. Whether it’s carrying heavy loads, navigating urban streets, or conquering steep inclines, the Cargoe T8 delivers exceptional performance with ease.

Spacious Cargo Bucket for All Your Needs

With a large, sturdy cargo bucket, the DAHON Cargoe T8 easily carries your folding bike, groceries, pets, or even your kids—making every ride practical and convenient

Patented Folding Technology

Featuring DAHON’s perfected folding mechanism, the bike folds quickly and securely, reducing its size by 35%. Perfect for elevators, tight spaces, and easy storage.

Landing-Gear Technology

Effortlessly move the folded bike, thanks to DAHON’s innovative third-wheel system for smooth mobility in tight areas.

Powerful Mid-Motor Drive

The mid-drive motor paired with a rear derailleur provides excellent torque, ensuring effortless riding on flat roads and strong climbing power on steep slopes.

Customizable Battery Options

Choose from different battery capacities to extend your range and meet your travel needs.
